id: title:jurajmajerik:retire legacy single recalculation time field

review.posthog_relevance: Removes legacy database column and model field for team experiment recalculation, retaining the list-based field. This could reduce database bloat and remove support for a deprecated API, though the chunk does not include the migration that actually drops the column, making it impossible to distinguish whether the change is a complete removal or a partial untracking.
